text:
Tara (People Ops): FYI, Imran flagged an urgent request: his IC got a counteroffer from another company. Manager asking for fast-track promo + comp bump to match offer. What do we need to move fast?
Imran (Eng Manager): Yep. Candidate has external offer: 155k base. Current comp 135k. We want 150k + title L4 effective 2026-04-05. Can comp fast-track outside normal window?
Sophie (Comp): We can escalate as a fast-track exception but need full packet. Required: external offer PDF, current comp evidence, manager calibration note, and 2 peer benchmarks. Also comp committee approval code will be generated (CC-FT-2026-04-07).
Tara (People Ops): Timeline? If we submit today, how long to decision? We need to respond to the candidate within 48 hours.
Comp-committee-bot: Fast-track SLA: committee triage within 24 hours, formal decision within 48 hours if all docs present. Missing items delay SLA.
Ben (Payroll): For payroll, if approval is after cutoff we will do retro to eff_date. For urgent cases we can request an off-cycle retro payout but that requires finance sign-off. Off-cycle payroll turnaround ~5 business days.
Imran (Eng Manager): For communication: should we tell candidate "pending comp committee approval" or confirm provisional offer? Concern about risk.
Sophie (Comp): Always say "pending internal approvals". If comp approves conditional on manager attestation and candidate acceptance, include that language. Also record whether base change affects bonus target for current cycle—pro-rate if eff_date mid-cycle.
Tara (People Ops): What about equity? Manager wants a small one-time RSU grant to sweeten offer. How do we label that?
Sophie (Comp): Label one-time RSU as OFFCYCLE_SIGNON in Workday payload. If it's a refresh, use PRORATE_REFRESH with percentage. Need vesting schedule and grant date.
Imran (Eng Manager): Ok. If we do 150k + OFFCYCLE_SIGNON 2000 RSU, manager wants it effective immediately on offer acceptance.
Ben (Payroll): For backpay CSV we need columns: employee_id, name, old_annual, new_annual, eff_date, comp_ticket, approver_code, equity_action, notes. Example row:
```
33221,Alex R,135000,150000,2026-04-05,CC-FT-2026-04-07,Sophie M,OFFCYCLE_SIGNON:2000,"Urgent retention; candidate accepted 2026-04-06"
```
Tara (People Ops): Any additional docs for finance? They wanted justification for immediate off-cycle cash if we request one.
Sophie (Comp): Include manager ROI note and brief headcount status. Finance OKs off-cycle cash only for documented retention risk. Add finance_approval_email link in the ticket.
Comp-committee-bot: Please upload packet to https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/fasttrack and tag @comp. Missing external offer or benchmarks will pause review.
Imran (Eng Manager): We'll upload now. If comp approves, what's the earliest payroll posting?
Ben (Payroll): If approved and submitted before payroll run 2026-04-08 00:00 PT we can include in 2026-04-15 posting with retro line. Off-cycle cash (if requested) targets 2026-04-12 payout but depends on finance clearance.
Tara (People Ops): Perfect. I'll assemble packet: offer PDF + benchmark table + manager calibration note + candidate acceptance email placeholder. Will include proposed comms wording: "pending approvals; effective date 2026-04-05; retro pay expected mid-April if approved after cutoff."
Sophie (Comp): One more: comp needs manager to confirm promoter-level evidence (impact examples, scope growth) — attach 1-page summary.
Imran (Eng Manager): Adding that. Thanks. We'll aim to get docs uploaded in next 2 hours.
Tara (People Ops): Thanks team. Will update thread once packet is uploaded and paste the fast-track ticket ID. :rocket:
